manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Changeling Hero must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Hero for its mana cost.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
